title: Residential roofing
shortDesc: Roofing for homes. Faber Roof states this on faberroof.com.
fullDesc: {{name}} says it provides roofing for homes as well as businesses. Call {{phone}} to ask about a house in {{city}}.
heading: Residential roofing
body: The current Faber Roof site describes the company as commercial and residential roofing. It does not publish a detailed residential scope, so call before assuming a specific material or repair.

faq.a: Faber Roof's site says it roofs homes and businesses. Call {{phone}} about a specific house.

title: Commercial roofing
shortDesc: Roofing for businesses, as stated on faberroof.com.
fullDesc: {{name}} says it provides roofing that protects businesses and homes. Call {{phone}} about a commercial property.
heading: Commercial roofing
body: Faber Roof's homepage says the company protects businesses and homes. It does not list flat-roof systems, so ask what the building needs.

faq.a: The site says Faber Roof does commercial and residential roofing. Call {{phone}} with the address.

title: Metal roofing
